Zanzibar President Visits India for Strategic Partnership Talks

The President of Zanzibar is on a four-day visit to India, engaging in discussions aimed at strengthening strategic partnerships. Meetings with External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar focused on enhancing cooperation in education, artificial intelligence, and digital sectors. This visit highlights India's growing diplomatic ties and potential for collaboration in key technological and educational areas.
